# LAB_SECRET

A secret the lab holds on the operator's machine, and the keys a cluster may read from it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `labSecret`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.labSecret`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| keys | attrs of record { generator, length } |
| kind | one of ["value", "ca"] |
| name | string |
